# Overview concept animation

`concept.gif` is an original, procedural engineering illustration, not experiment footage. `poster.png` is its static first frame for reduced-motion and pause states.

The ten-second loop shows a centre-mounted vertical pickup lowering a tethered ROV, release, independent swimming, return, brief magnetic capture, positive mechanical locking, then lift and stow. The drawn tether stays slack and is not used to pull the ROV into capture. The magnetic indicator turns off after the mechanical locks engage.

Hardware silhouettes and timings are illustrative; they do not establish OEM geometry, sensor range, structural capacity, integrated autonomy or field validation. No uploaded photos or real videos are included.

Run `python generate.py` with Pillow to reproduce the 1000 × 560, 80-frame, 8 fps GIF and first-frame PNG. `contact-sheet.jpg` is a six-state visual review artifact.
